morphology.pattern_note: 按数据包将整项作为独立单位保存。作为英语姓氏时通常写作 Michaels；末尾 s 读 /z/，不是马来语词缀，也不能据此认定为复数。

senses.zh_definition: 迈克尔斯；英语姓氏。缺少上下文时，不能确定具体指哪一个人或同名机构。
senses.en_definition: An English-language surname; the particular bearer or named entity requires context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga dalam penggunaan bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya dieja Michaels; orang atau entiti yang dirujuk perlu dikenal pasti melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，借用允许的 noun 标签表示；不是具有普通词汇释义的马来语名词。定义为编辑性说明，并非 DBP 官方释义。保留输入键的小写形式，正常行文使用 Michaels。下列为称谓和指称结构，不表示已核验的高频词汇搭配。[姓氏依据](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/michaels)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 虚构会议通知示例
dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Michaels akan menyampaikan pembentangan selepas sesi soal jawab.
dual_scenarios.zh: 迈克尔斯先生将在问答环节结束后作报告。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Michaels will give his presentation after the question-and-answer session.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Encik Michaels sudah tiba di pejabat?
dual_scenarios.zh: 迈克尔斯先生到办公室了吗？

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Encik Michaels dah sampai kat pejabat ke? Aku nak serahkan fail ni.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Encik Michaels sudah tiba di pejabat? Saya hendak menyerahkan fail ini.
messages.zh: 迈克尔斯先生到办公室了吗？我想把这份文件交给他。
messages.en: Has Mr Michaels arrived at the office? I need to give him this file.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia kat bilik mesyuarat. Tunggu kejap, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, beliau berada di bilik mesyuarat. Tunggu sebentar, ya.
messages.zh: 到了，他在会议室。稍等一下啊。
messages.en: Yes, he's in the meeting room. Just give him a moment.

etymology.historical_story: As a surname, Michaels belongs to the family of names derived from Michael. Surname references describe its final s as historically patronymic, genitival or, in some traditions, an added ending. That history does not make s a Malay suffix or identify a particular person's ancestry. In Malay text, the surname functions as a complete proper name. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Michaels)
